events.title: The Milanese defeat Lodrisio Visconti's mercenaries at Parabiago
events.description: Near Parabiago, in deep snow, the exiled Lodrisio Visconti's mercenary Compagnia di San Giorgio routed part of the Milanese army and captured Luchino Visconti. The Milanese rallied, freed Luchino and defeated Lodrisio.

events.title: Orkney and Shetland annexed to the Scottish crown
events.description: Pledged by Christian I of Denmark-Norway as security for his daughter's dowry when she married James III, the unredeemed islands were formally annexed by the Scottish Parliament.
events.html: Pledged by Christian I of Denmark-Norway as security for his daughter's dowry when she married James III, the unredeemed islands were formally annexed by the Scottish Parliament.

events.title: Nine-year-old Edward VI is crowned
events.description: Henry VIII's only son was crowned at Westminster Abbey. Under his regents England became firmly Protestant, but Edward died aged fifteen in 1553.
events.html: Henry VIII's only son was crowned at Westminster Abbey. Under his regents England became firmly Protestant, but Edward died aged fifteen in 1553.

events.title: Washington signs the Postal Service Act
events.description: The act established the US Post Office on a permanent footing and allowed newspapers to be mailed cheaply. It helped bind together a scattered young republic.
events.html: The act established the US Post Office on a permanent footing and allowed newspapers to be mailed cheaply. It helped bind together a scattered young republic.

events.title: The Union army suffers heavy losses at the Battle of Olustee
events.description: At the Battle of Olustee, or Ocean Pond, in Baker County near Lake City, the Union army suffered a casualty rate of one in three. It was the largest battle fought in Florida during the American Civil War.
events.html: At the Battle of Olustee, or Ocean Pond, in Baker County near Lake City, the Union army suffered a casualty rate of one in three. It was the largest battle fought in Florida during the American Civil War.

events.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art opens in New York
events.description: The museum opened in a former dance academy on Fifth Avenue with a modest collection. It moved to Central Park in 1880 and grew into one of the world's largest art museums.
events.html: The museum opened in a former dance academy on Fifth Avenue with a modest collection. It moved to Central Park in 1880 and grew into one of the world's largest art museums.

events.title: John Glenn becomes the first American to orbit Earth
events.description: Aboard Friendship 7, Glenn circled the Earth three times in under five hours. Ten months after Yuri Gagarin's flight, it restored American confidence in the space race.
events.html: Aboard Friendship 7, Glenn circled the Earth three times in under five hours. Ten months after Yuri Gagarin's flight, it restored American confidence in the space race.

events.title: Soviet Union launches the core of the Mir space station
events.description: Mir's first module was launched from Baikonur. Expanded over ten years, the station hosted crews from many nations and was continuously occupied for almost a decade before its re-entry in 2001.
